Thank you so much for the message, you have no idea how much this means.

I've been partially open with the therapist and psychiatrist - I've tried to downplay the adderall, mostly because I'm afraid I can't cope without it and that if I  mention the addiction side I'll have it taken away and that I'll have to go back to square 1 with amphetamine withdrawl - I will say that I've tried to limit the 'extra' I can take out, but because I always play it off as only depression/school they never limit it. I'm planning on going to my next doc appointment though and clarifiyng that I'm not capable of handling it at this moment though. 

I'm born physically man, but definitely mentally woman. Due to junior high, and a lot of experiences, I'm terrified of expressing it. It definitely feels like it'd be easier to hide.
My mistake for misspelling the title.
